text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Before heading 
to the waiting room, Admire Vega declared 
her victory once more to her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, her rivals weren't about to 
lose either. Holding onto their own 
reasons, her peers each headed toward the 
stage of the decisive battle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the stands— Narita Top Road had 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Defeating even the world's finest 
powerhouses to become a first-magnitude 
star. The Japan Cup finally gets underway.
